Superseded in SEQUENCING ONLY by EPIC P8 (bd-01KYTV6F3WM81HZNMT94W05V0T), lodged 2026-07-30 from docs/plans/2026-07-30-pre-1.0-correctness-and-architecture.md.

All five of this epic's structural gaps survive intact and no bead here is obsoleted. P7.2, P6f.12, P7.4 become P8 Phase E; P7.6 and P6f.18 become P8 Phase F; P7.1 feeds P8 Phase G4.

What changed and why: this epic established "representation (P7.2) before hand-writing codecs (P6f.12)". Verification of the 2026-07-29 external review found that public SHAPE must settle first as well — the LaunchSpec/PreparedJob split is a larger shape change than P7.2 is a representation change, and the state-model redesign alone touches 52 SlurmState references in protocol/AgentDomainJson.scala. P6f.12 and P7.6 therefore gain new blockers from P8 Phase D.

P7.5 is absorbed by P8.D5 and is a candidate for closure once D5 lands.
